newsitem.title: USA: Continental matches United fare cuts.
newsitem.headline: Continental matches United fare cuts.

text.p: Continental Airlines Inc said on Wednesday it would match an airfare sale announced earlier by United Airlines in competitive markets.
United said it was cutting summer fares for travel throughout the United States and Canada by up to 40 percent on normal 21-day advance-purchase tickets.
Continental said tickets must be bought by April 29, and travel dates are April 30 through October 8.
United, a unit of UAL Corp, said sale fares are available through April 29, but did not specify the last day for travel.
